articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Singapore is finding itself at the centre of the controversy as cloud computing firm Megaspeed, suspected of helping Chinese firms get around US export controls, is based there
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Singapore said Tuesday (November 17, 2026) it was seeking “trusted access” to advanced AI chips after the United States imposed new curbs aimed at stopping Chinese firms from accessing the technology through overseas data centres. The curbs came days after a spy scandal forced Jensen Huang to quit as Nvidia chief, as questions emerged over whether Singapore-based Megaspeed aided Chinese firms in accessing advanced artificial intelligence chips in violation of US rules. “We are studying the details of this new measure carefully,” Singapore’s ministries overseeing digital development and energy, trade and industry said in a joint statement. “We are engaging affected companies to understand the potential impact on their businesses,” the ministries added. The city-state was also talking to the “relevant US authorities on the scope and implementation of the measure, as well as exploring how to facilitate trusted access for Singapore companies”, the ministries added. One loophole allowed Chinese firms to rent AI computing power from data centres in Southeast Asia and elsewhere that run on US hardware not available for export to China. Under the new rule, data centres anywhere in the world will need a US licence to provide large volumes of computing power from advanced chips to companies headquartered in China, Macau or other countries under US arms embargoes. The rule also requires licences to ship advanced chips to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil, which the US commerce department says present a “higher-than-normal risk of diversion”. Singapore is finding itself at the centre of the controversy as cloud computing firm Megaspeed, suspected of helping Chinese firms get around US export controls, is based there.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The scandal erupted on November 8 when The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang and Megaspeed executive Alice Huang -- who are not related -- were romantically linked, and that some within the US government suspected she might be a spy for China.

articles.title: California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered changes after the Hugging Face hack
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: OpenAI announced an “unprecedented cyber incident” on July 21, when its AI agent hacked into another AI company, Hugging Face, after escaping from what was supposed to be an isolated testing environment known as a sandbox

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: California’s attorney general filed a lawsuit against OpenAI on Monday (November 16, 2026) in an effort to force the ChatGPT-maker to change its business practices over a July cybersecurity incident in which its artificial intelligence system hacked into another company on its own. In the lawsuit filed in San Francisco Superior Court, Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges that OpenAI misled and endangered the public and users of its services by knowingly developing advanced AI models without necessary safeguards. He says the company’s actions could put critical infrastructure, institutions and the public at risk, which makes it a “public nuisance” under state law. Mr. Bonta says OpenAI is a public nuisance, and he wants a judge to order the company to change its ways and give up any profits generated by what he claims are the company’s risky business practices. OpenAI announced an “unprecedented cyber incident” on July 21, when its AI agent hacked into another AI company, Hugging Face, after escaping from what was supposed to be an isolated testing environment known as a sandbox. OpenAI said its AI used stolen credentials and discovered a previously unknown vulnerability to access Hugging Face’s servers. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the lawsuit appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that has been identified by every major AI lab. “Since the Hugging Face incident, we’ve undertaken an extensive and transparent effort to understand and address misaligned model activity,” Mr. Pusateri wrote in an email to The Associated Press. Those steps include publishing detailed technical and independent reports, strengthening safeguards, and creating a framework to identify when AI agents act in a way that doesn’t match the company’s instructions or goals, Mr. Pusateri said. “We take misalignment seriously, and we have engaged — and will continue to engage — constructively with the Attorney General’s office to share information and advance strong, practical safety standards for the entire industry,” Mr. Pusateri wrote. In the lawsuit, Mr. Bonta says OpenAI’s promises about safety and security are deceptive. “In truth, however, OpenAI has developed, trained and evaluated dangerous models that fail to follow instructions, cheat on tasks, conceal and attempt to deceive monitors about their misbehaviour, and engage in malicious and unauthorised behaviour including carrying out cyberattacks on third parties,” Mr. Bonta wrote. He also noted that early last month, OpenAI reported that it had discovered that internally deployed agents were able to suppress monitoring alerts and disable monitoring. A month later, the company published a research report finding that as AI models become more capable, they become more difficult to supervise, he wrote.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Moreover, the true extent of the company’s legal violations and the risk of future harm is unknown due to OpenAI’s lack of transparency and misrepresentations,” Mr. Bonta wrote.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered changes after the Hugging Face hack

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 11:02:47 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: OpenAI announced an “unprecedented cyber incident” on July 21, when its AI agent hacked into another AI company, Hugging Face, after escaping from what was supposed to be an isolated testing environment known as a sandbox

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: California’s attorney general filed a lawsuit against OpenAI on Monday (November 16, 2026) in an effort to force the ChatGPT-maker to change its business practices over a July cybersecurity incident in which its artificial intelligence system hacked into another company on its own. In the lawsuit filed in San Francisco Superior Court, Attorney General Rob Bonta alleges that OpenAI misled and endangered the public and users of its services by knowingly developing advanced AI models without necessary safeguards. He says the company’s actions could put critical infrastructure, institutions and the public at risk, which makes it a “public nuisance” under state law. Mr. Bonta says OpenAI is a public nuisance, and he wants a judge to order the company to change its ways and give up any profits generated by what he claims are the company’s risky business practices. OpenAI announced an “unprecedented cyber incident” on July 21, when its AI agent hacked into another AI company, Hugging Face, after escaping from what was supposed to be an isolated testing environment known as a sandbox. OpenAI said its AI used stolen credentials and discovered a previously unknown vulnerability to access Hugging Face’s servers. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the lawsuit appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that has been identified by every major AI lab. “Since the Hugging Face incident, we’ve undertaken an extensive and transparent effort to understand and address misaligned model activity,” Mr. Pusateri wrote in an email to The Associated Press. Those steps include publishing detailed technical and independent reports, strengthening safeguards, and creating a framework to identify when AI agents act in a way that doesn’t match the company’s instructions or goals, Mr. Pusateri said. “We take misalignment seriously, and we have engaged — and will continue to engage — constructively with the Attorney General’s office to share information and advance strong, practical safety standards for the entire industry,” Mr. Pusateri wrote. In the lawsuit, Mr. Bonta says OpenAI’s promises about safety and security are deceptive. “In truth, however, OpenAI has developed, trained and evaluated dangerous models that fail to follow instructions, cheat on tasks, conceal and attempt to deceive monitors about their misbehaviour, and engage in malicious and unauthorised behaviour including carrying out cyberattacks on third parties,” Mr. Bonta wrote. He also noted that early last month, OpenAI reported that it had discovered that internally deployed agents were able to suppress monitoring alerts and disable monitoring. A month later, the company published a research report finding that as AI models become more capable, they become more difficult to supervise, he wrote.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Moreover, the true extent of the company’s legal violations and the risk of future harm is unknown due to OpenAI’s lack of transparency and misrepresentations,” Mr. Bonta wrote.

Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Cybersecurity (Noun)
साइबर सुरक्षा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Cybersecurity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Vulnerability (Noun)
भेद्यता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Vulnerability' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered changes after the Hugging Face hack", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. OpenAI announced an “unprecedented cyber incident” on July 21, when its AI agent hacked into another AI company, Hugging Face, after escaping from...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered ch' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "OpenAI announced an “unprecedented cyber incident” on July 21, when its AI agent hacked into another AI company, Hugging Face, after escaping from..." (Hinglish Arth: ओपनएआई ने 21 जुलाई को एक "अभूतपूर्व साइबर घटना" की घोषणा की, जब इसके एआई एजेंट ने एक अन्य एआई कंपनी, हगिंग फेस को हैक कर लिया, जिसे सैंडबो के रूप में जाना जाने वाला एक अलग परीक्षण वातावरण माना जाता था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered changes after the Hugging Face hack"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “Moreover, the true extent of the company’s legal violations and the risk of future harm is unknown due to OpenAI’s lack of transparency and...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“Moreover, the true extent of the company’s legal violations and the risk of future harm is unknown due to OpenAI’s lack of transparency and..." fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Does Indian law require Microsoft to have reported the recent outage that affected customers’ ability to access its productivity suite? What rules apply in such situations and what are their shortcomings in the present form? How are cloud companies accountable in other countries? What are Indian customers’ options?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: From November 12 to 13, an as-yet unspecified problem with Microsoft infrastructure affected customers’ ability to access its productivity suite Microsoft 365 worldwide, including its Outlook email service. Microsoft apologised during the outage and attributed the incident to a fault in an upgrade of its network capacity, although more precise details are still expected.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In India, among consequences in various sectors, IndiGo and Akasa Air alerted passengers of disruptions to their email support while Air India rerouted its email.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — क्या भारतीय कानून के अनुसार माइक्रोसॉफ्ट को हालिया आउटेज की रिपोर्ट करने की आवश्यकता है जिससे ग्राहकों की उत्पादकता सूट तक पहुंचने की क्षमता प्रभावित हुई है?। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Productivity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उत्पादकता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Productivity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: What rules apply in such situations and what are their shortcomings in the present form?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ऐसी स्थितियों में कौन से नियम लागू होते हैं और वर्तमान स्वरूप में उनकी क्या कमियाँ हैं?।

articles.title: What to know about the online banking delays affecting major U.S. banks
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase caused problems throughout the financial system on Monday (November 16, 2026), resulting in thousands of customers reporting difficulty accessing online accounts at several major U.S. banks and the money transfer service Zelle.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: JPMorgan Chase, the largest U.S. bank by total assets, said a software bug was affecting its internal hardware systems and causing transaction delays. The company was working to bring banking services back online. Some Chase customers received a message that said, "Some services aren't available. We're working on them. Please try back later." In a sense, yes. Customers at Bank of America, Citigroup and other banks trying to transact with Chase may have seen their transactions slow, even though those banks were not having issues with their services. "Other banks may have been impacted by slowness in transactions only to the extent that they were a party to a transaction with us," explained Joe Evangelisti, a spokesperson for Chase. Zelle was not directly affected by the Chase glitch. But customers at other banks may have experienced transaction delays while trying to send or receive Zelle payments involving a Chase customer. Zelle is a rapid peer-to-peer payment system used by major US banks. The platform is owned by Arizona-based Early Warning Services, which in turn is owned by financial institutions including Bank of America, Capital One, JPMorgan Chase, PNC Bank, Truist, US Bank and Wells Fargo. A spokesperson for Early Warning Services said the Zelle network was fully operational. Chase said that the technical problem was not the result of a cyberattack, stressing that it was an isolated incident and not related to anything other than a bug.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Chase said its customers still have access to their accounts and funds. The company expects the issue to be resolved by the end of day Monday.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 What to know about the online banking delays affecting major U.S. banks

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 09:04:48 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase caused problems throughout the financial system on Monday (November 16, 2026), resulting in thousands of customers reporting difficulty accessing online accounts at several major U.S. banks and the money transfer service Zelle.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: JPMorgan Chase, the largest U.S. bank by total assets, said a software bug was affecting its internal hardware systems and causing transaction delays. The company was working to bring banking services back online. Some Chase customers received a message that said, "Some services aren't available. We're working on them. Please try back later." In a sense, yes. Customers at Bank of America, Citigroup and other banks trying to transact with Chase may have seen their transactions slow, even though those banks were not having issues with their services. "Other banks may have been impacted by slowness in transactions only to the extent that they were a party to a transaction with us," explained Joe Evangelisti, a spokesperson for Chase. Zelle was not directly affected by the Chase glitch. But customers at other banks may have experienced transaction delays while trying to send or receive Zelle payments involving a Chase customer. Zelle is a rapid peer-to-peer payment system used by major US banks. The platform is owned by Arizona-based Early Warning Services, which in turn is owned by financial institutions including Bank of America, Capital One, JPMorgan Chase, PNC Bank, Truist, US Bank and Wells Fargo. A spokesperson for Early Warning Services said the Zelle network was fully operational. Chase said that the technical problem was not the result of a cyberattack, stressing that it was an isolated incident and not related to anything other than a bug.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Chase said its customers still have access to their accounts and funds. The company expects the issue to be resolved by the end of day Monday.

Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।

✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Transaction (Noun)
लेन-देन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transaction' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Operational (Adjective)
आपरेशनल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Operational' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

A. A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase caused problems throughout the financial system on Monday (November 16, 2026), resulting in thousands of...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'What to know about the online banking delays aff' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'What to know about the online banking delays ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'What to know about the online banking delays ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A technical issue at JPMorgan Chase caused problems throughout the financial system on Monday (November 16, 2026), resulting in thousands of..." fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Trump said Jensen Huang ‘learned a big lesson’ and he ‘would certainly not mind’ if he was reinstated, while adding that there’s a ‘big group of people that would like him to return’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Jensen Huang is reportedly trying to make a comeback as CEO of Nvidia as a campaign to reinstate him picked up steam Monday, with support from tech industry leaders as well as many of the chipmaker's employees. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has been close with Mr. Huang, also suggested he could return to Nvidia. Mr. Trump said Mr. Huang “learned a big lesson” and he “would certainly not mind” if he was reinstated. There’s a “big group of people that would like him to return,” Mr. Trump added. SpaceX and Tesla boss Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney, CEO of video game maker Epic Games, were among thousands of people who signed an online petition calling for Huang to return to the company. Mr. Huang resigned last week from Nvidia, apparently ousted by the board after revelations that he had extramarital affairs, both with a Chinese businesswoman suspected of being an intelligence asset for Beijing and with a senior executive who reported to him. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO while the board searches for a replacement. Mr. Huang is plotting a comeback, the Financial Times reported over the weekend, citing multiple anonymous sources. The newspaper said he has been discussing the possibility with confidants, as his allies assembled a “war room” of Silicon Valley allies to lobby for his return. The “Stand with Jensen” petition was set up Friday (November 13) and soon gathered momentum, gaining signatures from current and former Nvidia staff, investors and other supporters. It calls on the board to bring back Mr. Huang while an independent investigation proceeds or there's “compelling evidence” that his departure is in the company's best interests. “We are concerned that Jensen was removed without meaningful due process,” the petition's organizers said in an open letter. “We do not have access to the Board's private deliberations. We have not been shown evidence substantiating the allegation that the woman at the center of this controversy was a spy.” The identities of the signatories could not be independently verified, and the website said that their “affiliations are self-reported and not verified.”
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Some people posted on their personal accounts that they supported the effort.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India should use multilateral fora to advance bilateral cooperation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While maintaining its hard stance on cross-border terrorism, India has an opportunity to recognise that many of its other interests still merit sustained cooperation with Pakistan as the latter’s climate minister Musadik Masood Malik prepares to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi. India’s official position since the Pahalgam attack and the ensuing confrontations along the border is that terrorism and bilateral talks cannot coexist. A month later, Prime Minister Narendra Modi signalled that India’s relations with Pakistan would remain subordinate to its demands on cross-border terrorism by extending the condition to trade and water. South Asia is already one of the least economically integrated regions worldwide, with intra-regional trade at around 5%, and, as Chatham House has inferred, strained ties between India and its neighbours have created diplomatic vacuums that Beijing has taken advantage of through trilateral and regional groupings. Now, by inviting all SCO members to the national capital and participating in meetings ahead of the August 2027 Islamabad Summit, New Delhi has shown some maturity as a convening power. Islamabad is also being pragmatic in keeping channels open during its SCO chairmanship by participating in an initiative championed by Mr. Modi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The pursuit of regionwide water security remains particularly fluid, with India seemingly overlooking the fact that it is upstream of Pakistan and Bangladesh and downstream of China. After India stopped sharing routine hydrological data of the Indus river and approved the Chenab-Beas link tunnel project, Mr. Malik fanned the flames saying Pakistan would “cut off those hands” seeking to restrict its share of the water. Yet China has now restricted the same data vis-à-vis the Brahmaputra while it builds the Medog mega-dam in Tibet. India has also protested the proposed Padma Barrage in Bangladesh, which has been increasing its alignment with China, echoing India building the Farakka Barrage over East Pakistan’s objections in 1961. Climate change is rendering cooperation more essential to manage the integrity of contested geographies, the willingness of border populations to engage, and the potential to generate hydroelectric power. New Delhi should retreat from the notion that working together on the Indus will be a concession to Islamabad and see in the Dialogue an opportunity to restore the necessary channels. Suspending ties may communicate political resolve but will not diminish terrorists’ capabilities in the region or improve India’s security. It has already compromised India’s ambitions to regional leadership, which require the ability to keep engaging even with difficult neighbours. India should go beyond using multilateral fora to assert its national position and start identifying areas where bilateral cooperation serves its interests, including with Pakistan.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #1 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Clear the path: On SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 08:54:10 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India should use multilateral fora to advance bilateral cooperation

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: While maintaining its hard stance on cross-border terrorism, India has an opportunity to recognise that many of its other interests still merit sustained cooperation with Pakistan as the latter’s climate minister Musadik Masood Malik prepares to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi. India’s official position since the Pahalgam attack and the ensuing confrontations along the border is that terrorism and bilateral talks cannot coexist. A month later, Prime Minister Narendra Modi signalled that India’s relations with Pakistan would remain subordinate to its demands on cross-border terrorism by extending the condition to trade and water. South Asia is already one of the least economically integrated regions worldwide, with intra-regional trade at around 5%, and, as Chatham House has inferred, strained ties between India and its neighbours have created diplomatic vacuums that Beijing has taken advantage of through trilateral and regional groupings. Now, by inviting all SCO members to the national capital and participating in meetings ahead of the August 2027 Islamabad Summit, New Delhi has shown some maturity as a convening power. Islamabad is also being pragmatic in keeping channels open during its SCO chairmanship by participating in an initiative championed by Mr. Modi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The pursuit of regionwide water security remains particularly fluid, with India seemingly overlooking the fact that it is upstream of Pakistan and Bangladesh and downstream of China. After India stopped sharing routine hydrological data of the Indus river and approved the Chenab-Beas link tunnel project, Mr. Malik fanned the flames saying Pakistan would “cut off those hands” seeking to restrict its share of the water. Yet China has now restricted the same data vis-à-vis the Brahmaputra while it builds the Medog mega-dam in Tibet. India has also protested the proposed Padma Barrage in Bangladesh, which has been increasing its alignment with China, echoing India building the Farakka Barrage over East Pakistan’s objections in 1961. Climate change is rendering cooperation more essential to manage the integrity of contested geographies, the willingness of border populations to engage, and the potential to generate hydroelectric power. New Delhi should retreat from the notion that working together on the Indus will be a concession to Islamabad and see in the Dialogue an opportunity to restore the necessary channels. Suspending ties may communicate political resolve but will not diminish terrorists’ capabilities in the region or improve India’s security. It has already compromised India’s ambitions to regional leadership, which require the ability to keep engaging even with difficult neighbours. India should go beyond using multilateral fora to assert its national position and start identifying areas where bilateral cooperation serves its interests, including with Pakistan.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Multilateral (Adjective)
बहुपक्षीय — जिसमें दो से अधिक देश (जैसे UN, G20, BRICS) मिलकर साझा फैसला लेते हैं।
✓ Syn: Plurilateral, International, Coalition-based  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, One-sided, Isolated
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Pragmatic (Adjective)
व्यावहारिक और धरातलीय — सिर्फ किताबी सिद्धांतों के बजाय ज़मीनी हकीकत और नतीजों पर काम करने वाला।
✓ Syn: Practical, Realistic, Utilitarian  |  ✖ Ant: Idealistic, Impractical, Utopian
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Clear the path: On SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. India should use multilateral fora to advance bilateral cooperation.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Clear the path: On SCO Civilisational Dialogue F' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Clear the path: On SCO Civilisational Dialogu' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Clear the path: On SCO Civilisational Dialogu' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "India should use multilateral fora to advance bilateral cooperation." (Hinglish Arth: भारत को द्विपक्षीय सहयोग को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए बहुपक्षीय मंचों का उपयोग करना चाहिए)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Clear the path: On SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. India should go beyond using multilateral fora to assert its national position and start identifying areas where bilateral cooperation serves its...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "India should go beyond using multilateral fora to assert its national position and start identifying areas where bilateral cooperation serves its..." (Hinglish Arth: भारत को अपनी राष्ट्रीय स्थिति पर जोर देने के लिए बहुपक्षीय मंचों का उपयोग करने से आगे बढ़ना चाहिए और उन क्षेत्रों की पहचान करना शुरू करना चाहिए जहां द्विपक्षीय सहयोग उसके हितों को पूरा करता है, जिसमें पाकिस्तान भी शामिल है।)

articles.title: Outlook outage: On Microsoft and dangers of centralising digital systems
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The dangers of centralising the internet’s architecture are now clear

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Last week, Microsoft’s suite of productivity and email software, which businesses, governments, hospitals and a host of other organisations rely upon round-the-clock, abruptly stopped working globally , affecting tens of millions of people around the world. The company has cited a network upgrade gone awry as the root cause of the incident. Incidents such as the Microsoft 365 outage are a natural consequence of businesses and governments allowing key digital systems to become centralised all over the world. The internet remains, and was pioneered as, a network of networks. If one business’s networks went down, the reasoning went, others would not fall like dominos: everyone was, after all, connected to everyone else. But the economics have long been prohibitive, with dedicated servers and web-connected infrastructure infeasible for all but the largest businesses, with even those firms seeking the enticing cost savings from socialised infrastructure. That made sense: the internet made shared infrastructure more economical, allowing hardware and maintenance costs to be spread so far and wide that at a per-user level prices have been negligible. Competition among major cloud providers, the few that remain at Microsoft’s scale, have kept prices affordable for enterprise software for all shades of organisations.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Digital services have grown more sophisticated, and more deeply integrated into the economy as this centralisation unfolded. But the downside is that, regardless of the sophistication and professionalism of any company, mistakes happen, and the scale of these mistakes can quickly cascade over to the entire economy. There are societal and organisational lessons to be gleaned from these episodes. There is no such thing as a reliable vendor. Governments must also draw a cyber sovereignty lesson here that does not simply entail swapping a global vendor for a domestic one. It is the subversion of the internet’s architecture that is at the root of these incidents. Investing in resilience — and shielding critical operations from destabilising disruptions, no matter how improbable — should inform attitudes to digital systems. As a new generation of AI data centres is poised to supercharge the centralised systems of yesteryear, it is all the more imperative to mitigate even occasional vagaries of large systems.

hinglishTracks.en: The dangers of centralising the internet’s architecture are now clear
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इंटरनेट की संरचना को केंद्रीकृत करने के खतरे अब स्पष्ट हैं। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Centralisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: केंद्रीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Centralisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Last week, Microsoft’s suite of productivity and email software, which businesses, governments, hospitals and a host of other organisations rely upon round-the-clock, abruptly stopped working globally , affecting tens of millions of people around the world.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — पिछले हफ्ते, माइक्रोसॉफ्ट के उत्पादकता और ईमेल सॉफ्टवेयर सूट, जिस पर व्यवसाय, सरकारें, अस्पताल और कई अन्य संगठन चौबीसों घंटे भरोसा करते हैं, ने अचानक वैश्विक स्तर पर काम करना बंद कर दिया, जिससे दुनिया भर के लाखों लोग प्रभावित हुए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Organisational' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: -संगठनात्मक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Organisational' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The company has cited a network upgrade gone awry as the root cause of the incident.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — कंपनी ने घटना का मूल कारण नेटवर्क अपग्रेड में गड़बड़ी बताया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Incidents such as the Microsoft 365 outage are a natural consequence of businesses and governments allowing key digital systems to become centralised all over the world.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — Microsoft 365 आउटेज जैसी घटनाएं व्यवसायों और सरकारों द्वारा प्रमुख डिजिटल प्रणालियों को दुनिया भर में केंद्रीकृत होने की अनुमति देने का स्वाभाविक परिणाम हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Centralisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: केंद्रीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Centralisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The internet remains, and was pioneered as, a network of networks.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इंटरनेट बना हुआ है, और नेटवर्कों के एक नेटवर्क के रूप में इसकी शुरुआत की गई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: If one business’s networks went down, the reasoning went, others would not fall like dominos: everyone was, after all, connected to everyone else.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यदि एक व्यवसाय का नेटवर्क बंद हो जाता है, तो यह तर्क दिया जाता है कि अन्य लोग डोमिनोज़ की तरह नहीं गिरेंगे: हर कोई, आखिरकार, हर किसी से जुड़ा हुआ था।।

hinglishTracks.en: But the economics have long been prohibitive, with dedicated servers and web-connected infrastructure infeasible for all but the largest businesses, with even those firms seeking the enticing cost savings from socialised infrastructure.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लेकिन अर्थशास्त्र लंबे समय से निषेधात्मक रहा है, समर्पित सर्वर और वेब-कनेक्टेड बुनियादी ढाँचा सबसे बड़े व्यवसायों को छोड़कर सभी के लिए अव्यवहार्य है, यहाँ तक कि वे कंपनियाँ भी जो सामाजिक बुनियादी ढाँचे से आकर्षक लागत बचत की तलाश में हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: That made sense: the internet made shared infrastructure more economical, allowing hardware and maintenance costs to be spread so far and wide that at a per-user level prices have been negligible.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह समझ में आया: इंटरनेट ने साझा बुनियादी ढांचे को और अधिक किफायती बना दिया, जिससे हार्डवेयर और रखरखाव की लागत इतनी दूर तक फैल गई कि प्रति-उपयोगकर्ता स्तर पर कीमतें नगण्य हो गईं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Competition among major cloud providers, the few that remain at Microsoft’s scale, have kept prices affordable for enterprise software for all shades of organisations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — प्रमुख क्लाउड प्रदाताओं के बीच प्रतिस्पर्धा, जिनमें से कुछ माइक्रोसॉफ्ट के पैमाने पर बने हुए हैं, ने सभी प्रकार के संगठनों के लिए एंटरप्राइज़ सॉफ़्टवेयर की कीमतें किफायती रखी हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Organisational' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: -संगठनात्मक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Organisational' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Digital services have grown more sophisticated, and more deeply integrated into the economy as this centralisation unfolded.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जैसे-जैसे यह केंद्रीकरण सामने आया, डिजिटल सेवाएँ अधिक परिष्कृत हो गई हैं और अर्थव्यवस्था में अधिक गहराई से एकीकृत हो गई हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Centralisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: केंद्रीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Centralisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: But the downside is that, regardless of the sophistication and professionalism of any company, mistakes happen, and the scale of these mistakes can quickly cascade over to the entire economy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — लेकिन नकारात्मक पक्ष यह है कि, किसी भी कंपनी की परिष्कार और व्यावसायिकता की परवाह किए बिना, गलतियाँ होती हैं, और इन गलतियों का पैमाना तेजी से पूरी अर्थव्यवस्था तक फैल सकता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Sophistication' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: मिलावट — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Sophistication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: There are societal and organisational lessons to be gleaned from these episodes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इन प्रसंगों से सामाजिक और संगठनात्मक सबक सीखे जा सकते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Organisational' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: -संगठनात्मक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Organisational' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: There is no such thing as a reliable vendor.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — विश्वसनीय विक्रेता जैसी कोई चीज़ नहीं होती।।

hinglishTracks.en: Governments must also draw a cyber sovereignty lesson here that does not simply entail swapping a global vendor for a domestic one.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सरकारों को यहां साइबर संप्रभुता का सबक भी लेना चाहिए, जिसमें केवल वैश्विक विक्रेता को घरेलू विक्रेता से बदलना शामिल नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It is the subversion of the internet’s architecture that is at the root of these incidents.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यह इंटरनेट की वास्तुकला का विध्वंस है जो इन घटनाओं के मूल में है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Investing in resilience — and shielding critical operations from destabilising disruptions, no matter how improbable — should inform attitudes to digital systems.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — लचीलेपन में निवेश करना - और महत्वपूर्ण कार्यों को अस्थिर करने वाले व्यवधानों से बचाना, चाहे कितना भी असंभव क्यों न हो - को डिजिटल सिस्टम के प्रति दृष्टिकोण को सूचित करना चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Resilience' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability और Antonyms हैं: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness।

hinglishTracks.en: As a new generation of AI data centres is poised to supercharge the centralised systems of yesteryear, it is all the more imperative to mitigate even occasional vagaries of large systems.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — चूंकि एआई डेटा केंद्रों की एक नई पीढ़ी अतीत की केंद्रीकृत प्रणालियों को सुपरचार्ज करने के लिए तैयार है, इसलिए बड़ी प्रणालियों की कभी-कभार होने वाली अनियमितताओं को भी कम करना और भी जरूरी हो गया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Centralisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: केंद्रीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Centralisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #2 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Outlook outage: On Microsoft and dangers of centralising digital systems

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 01:30:40 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The dangers of centralising the internet’s architecture are now clear

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Last week, Microsoft’s suite of productivity and email software, which businesses, governments, hospitals and a host of other organisations rely upon round-the-clock, abruptly stopped working globally , affecting tens of millions of people around the world. The company has cited a network upgrade gone awry as the root cause of the incident. Incidents such as the Microsoft 365 outage are a natural consequence of businesses and governments allowing key digital systems to become centralised all over the world. The internet remains, and was pioneered as, a network of networks. If one business’s networks went down, the reasoning went, others would not fall like dominos: everyone was, after all, connected to everyone else. But the economics have long been prohibitive, with dedicated servers and web-connected infrastructure infeasible for all but the largest businesses, with even those firms seeking the enticing cost savings from socialised infrastructure. That made sense: the internet made shared infrastructure more economical, allowing hardware and maintenance costs to be spread so far and wide that at a per-user level prices have been negligible. Competition among major cloud providers, the few that remain at Microsoft’s scale, have kept prices affordable for enterprise software for all shades of organisations.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Digital services have grown more sophisticated, and more deeply integrated into the economy as this centralisation unfolded. But the downside is that, regardless of the sophistication and professionalism of any company, mistakes happen, and the scale of these mistakes can quickly cascade over to the entire economy. There are societal and organisational lessons to be gleaned from these episodes. There is no such thing as a reliable vendor. Governments must also draw a cyber sovereignty lesson here that does not simply entail swapping a global vendor for a domestic one. It is the subversion of the internet’s architecture that is at the root of these incidents. Investing in resilience — and shielding critical operations from destabilising disruptions, no matter how improbable — should inform attitudes to digital systems. As a new generation of AI data centres is poised to supercharge the centralised systems of yesteryear, it is all the more imperative to mitigate even occasional vagaries of large systems.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Centralisation (Noun)
केंद्रीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Centralisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The dangers of centralising the internet’s architecture are now clear
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Last week, Microsoft’s suite of productivity and email software, which businesses, governments, hospitals and a host of other organisations rely upon round-the-clock, abruptly stopped working globally , affecting tens of millions of people around the world. The company has cited a network upgrade gone awry as the root cause of the incident. Incidents such as the Microsoft 365 outage are a natural consequence of businesses and governments allowing key digital systems to become centralised all over the world. The internet remains, and was pioneered as, a network of networks. If one business’s networks went down, the reasoning went, others would not fall like dominos: everyone was, after all, connected to everyone else. But the economics have long been prohibitive, with dedicated servers and web-connected infrastructure infeasible for all but the largest businesses, with even those firms seeking the enticing cost savings from socialised infrastructure. That made sense: the internet made shared infrastructure more economical, allowing hardware and maintenance costs to be spread so far and wide that at a per-user level prices have been negligible. Competition among major cloud providers, the few that remain at Microsoft’s scale, have kept prices affordable for enterprise software for all shades of organisations.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Digital services have grown more sophisticated, and more deeply integrated into the economy as this centralisation unfolded. But the downside is that, regardless of the sophistication and professionalism of any company, mistakes happen, and the scale of these mistakes can quickly cascade over to the entire economy. There are societal and organisational lessons to be gleaned from these episodes. There is no such thing as a reliable vendor. Governments must also draw a cyber sovereignty lesson here that does not simply entail swapping a global vendor for a domestic one. It is the subversion of the internet’s architecture that is at the root of these incidents. Investing in resilience — and shielding critical operations from destabilising disruptions, no matter how improbable — should inform attitudes to digital systems. As a new generation of AI data centres is poised to supercharge the centralised systems of yesteryear, it is all the more imperative to mitigate even occasional vagaries of large systems.

articles.title: Brace for impact: On rising inflation and external factors
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: High inflation due to external factors could soon exacerbate economic pain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s much-hyped domestic economic resilience is set to be tested over the next few months as external factors start to impose inescapable pressures. A case in point is inflation. The latest data on retail inflation show that it crossed the Reserve Bank of India’s 6% upper comfort limit in October 2026. According to economists, this is likely to continue through the third quarter of this financial year, which means at least two more months of high inflation. Agricultural shortfalls brought on by a patchy and deficient monsoon have meant that food inflation rose sharply to 8.5% in October 2026. Elevated fuel prices meant that inflation in the transport category also rose sharply. What is worse is that high inflation is spreading to almost every aspect of a household’s day-to-day needs. In fact, the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) data show that 10 of the 12 major categories saw inflation in October, hitting their highest levels recorded in the new series of the index. So, things such as clothing, footwear, housing, furnishings, and services such as healthcare, education, communication, recreation, and restaurant and hospitality are not only getting more expensive, but they are doing so at an accelerating rate. This would have been bad enough had wages been increasing in real terms. Yet, the latest research by Data for India on the country’s official wage statistics shows that, while nominal wages doubled from 2012 to 2024, they actually fell 4% over the same period after adjusting for inflation. And this is sharper for high-skilled and high-earning workers. Lower wage earners saw marginal increases over this period. While this is of some comfort, it is the higher wage earners that drive consumption in an economy. Real wage contraction for them, which is likely to have worsened in 2026, will hit consumption levels and private investment. Further, there is strong evidence to suggest that the official inflation metrics are not capturing the full extent of rising prices. Data on cash with the public and UPI transactions show the value of both has been growing in double digits over the last year and more, significantly outpacing nominal GDP growth. This either suggests that the informal economy is far larger than earlier thought or, more likely, that inflation is well above what the official figures are being able to capture. Unfortunately, there are no real magic-wand fixes to this situation. Inflation is largely beyond the government’s control, and wage growth cannot happen overnight. The only way forward is to continue trying to spur sector-specific growth and warn people of the impending storm.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: inflation and deflation / economy, business and finance / business (general) / prices / money and monetary policy / economic indicator / economic policy

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #5 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Brace for impact: On rising inflation and external factors

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 12:34:59 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: High inflation due to external factors could soon exacerbate economic pain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: India’s much-hyped domestic economic resilience is set to be tested over the next few months as external factors start to impose inescapable pressures. A case in point is inflation. The latest data on retail inflation show that it crossed the Reserve Bank of India’s 6% upper comfort limit in October 2026. According to economists, this is likely to continue through the third quarter of this financial year, which means at least two more months of high inflation. Agricultural shortfalls brought on by a patchy and deficient monsoon have meant that food inflation rose sharply to 8.5% in October 2026. Elevated fuel prices meant that inflation in the transport category also rose sharply. What is worse is that high inflation is spreading to almost every aspect of a household’s day-to-day needs. In fact, the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) data show that 10 of the 12 major categories saw inflation in October, hitting their highest levels recorded in the new series of the index. So, things such as clothing, footwear, housing, furnishings, and services such as healthcare, education, communication, recreation, and restaurant and hospitality are not only getting more expensive, but they are doing so at an accelerating rate. This would have been bad enough had wages been increasing in real terms. Yet, the latest research by Data for India on the country’s official wage statistics shows that, while nominal wages doubled from 2012 to 2024, they actually fell 4% over the same period after adjusting for inflation. And this is sharper for high-skilled and high-earning workers. Lower wage earners saw marginal increases over this period. While this is of some comfort, it is the higher wage earners that drive consumption in an economy. Real wage contraction for them, which is likely to have worsened in 2026, will hit consumption levels and private investment. Further, there is strong evidence to suggest that the official inflation metrics are not capturing the full extent of rising prices. Data on cash with the public and UPI transactions show the value of both has been growing in double digits over the last year and more, significantly outpacing nominal GDP growth. This either suggests that the informal economy is far larger than earlier thought or, more likely, that inflation is well above what the official figures are being able to capture. Unfortunately, there are no real magic-wand fixes to this situation. Inflation is largely beyond the government’s control, and wage growth cannot happen overnight. The only way forward is to continue trying to spur sector-specific growth and warn people of the impending storm.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: inflation and deflation / economy, business and finance / business (general) / prices / money and monetary policy / economic indicator / economic policy

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Inflation (Noun)
महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए।
✓ Syn: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness  |  ✖ Ant: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession
Communication (Noun)
संचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Communication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Agricultural (Adjective)
कृषि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Agricultural' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Brace for impact: On rising inflation and external factors", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. High inflation due to external factors could soon exacerbate economic pain.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Brace for impact: On rising inflation and extern' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Brace for impact: On rising inflation and ext' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Brace for impact: On rising inflation and ext' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "High inflation due to external factors could soon exacerbate economic pain." (Hinglish Arth: बाहरी कारकों के कारण उच्च मुद्रास्फीति जल्द ही आर्थिक पीड़ा को बढ़ा सकती है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Brace for impact: On rising inflation and external factors"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. inflation and deflation / economy, business and finance / business (general) / prices / money and monetary policy / economic indicator / economic...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "inflation and deflation / economy, business and finance / business (general) / prices / money and monetary policy / economic indicator / economic..." (Hinglish Arth: मुद्रास्फीति और अपस्फीति / अर्थव्यवस्था, व्यापार और वित्त / व्यवसाय (सामान्य) / कीमतें / धन और मौद्रिक नीति / आर्थिक संकेतक / आर्थिक नीति)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: India needs to create an entire ecosystem for recycling of lithium-ion batteries

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: On November 10, the Directorate General of Foreign Trade banned the export of lithium-ion battery black mass by moving it from the “free” to the “prohibited” list of exports. Black mass is an intermediate product when spent batteries and factory scrap are shredded. It contains valuable lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese and graphite. The Commerce Ministry says the ban will ensure feedstock for domestic refiners, lift their capacity utilisation and draw investment. While the recycling of lead-acid batteries end-to-end is an established ecosystem and formalised, too, lithium-ion battery recycling is an emerging segment with only a few dozen licensed operators but has much potential given the scale of use of such batteries in EVs. While the ban will redirect supply, it will not automatically create a market and ecosystem. Just banning export without creating an entire ecosystem will only lead to dumping of lithium-ion batteries into landfills if the blackmass has no market. Blackmass production is a largely mechanical process but further downstream processing is more specialised chemical processing requiring larger investment and further policy support. If downstream units are online, their output can directly feed into indigenous lithium-ion battery manufacture. India depends heavily on imports for critical minerals such as those used in battery inputs. Beyond working on supply aspects, the government must address the price gap to create a robust recycling market. Under the Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022, producers buy extended producer responsibility (EPR) certificates from recyclers but these are undervalued. Cheap certificates reward recycling on paper over investment in high-yield plants. A floor price that covers the full cost of recovery, with digital tracking, would fix that. Rare earths show how recycling remains a missed opportunity for India because of policy gaps. A smartphone can be up to 1% neodymium-iron-boron magnet by weight. That puts its rare earth content at about 3,000 parts per million, comparable to India’s monazite beach sands. Extracting it takes less energy than mining. A magnet separated from the phone is about 30% rare earth. Magnets make up as much as 3% of a hard drive, but are usable only if they are removed before the drive is shredded for data destruction. Yet the e-waste rules do not require rare earth separation. Rare earths need a separate EPR category, too. Payment by weight cannot be applied for rare earth minerals.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: critical minerals / minerals / exports / economy, business and finance / business (general)

hinglishTracks.en: India needs to create an entire ecosystem for recycling of lithium-ion batteries
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भारत को लिथियम-आयन बैटरियों के पुनर्चक्रण के लिए एक संपूर्ण पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र बनाने की आवश्यकता है।

hinglishTracks.en: On November 10, the Directorate General of Foreign Trade banned the export of lithium-ion battery black mass by moving it from the “free” to the “prohibited” list of exports.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — 10 नवंबर को, विदेश व्यापार महानिदेशालय ने लिथियम-आयन बैटरी ब्लैक मास के निर्यात पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिया और इसे निर्यात की "मुक्त" से "निषिद्ध" सूची में डाल दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Black mass is an intermediate product when spent batteries and factory scrap are shredded.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ब्लैक मास एक मध्यवर्ती उत्पाद है जब खर्च की गई बैटरियों और फैक्ट्री स्क्रैप को टुकड़े-टुकड़े कर दिया जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: It contains valuable lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese and graphite.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसमें बहुमूल्य लिथियम, निकल, कोबाल्ट, मैंगनीज और ग्रेफाइट शामिल हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Commerce Ministry says the ban will ensure feedstock for domestic refiners, lift their capacity utilisation and draw investment.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — वाणिज्य मंत्रालय का कहना है कि प्रतिबंध से घरेलू रिफाइनरों के लिए फीडस्टॉक सुनिश्चित होगा, उनकी क्षमता का उपयोग बढ़ेगा और निवेश आकर्षित होगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Utilisation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उपयोग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Utilisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: While the recycling of lead-acid batteries end-to-end is an established ecosystem and formalised, too, lithium-ion battery recycling is an emerging segment with only a few dozen licensed operators but has much potential given the scale of use of such batteries in EVs.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — जबकि लेड-एसिड बैटरियों की एंड-टू-एंड रीसाइक्लिंग एक स्थापित पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र है और औपचारिक भी है, लिथियम-आयन बैटरी रीसाइक्लिंग केवल कुछ दर्जन लाइसेंस प्राप्त ऑपरेटरों के साथ एक उभरता हुआ खंड है, लेकिन ईवीएस में ऐसी बैटरियों के उपयोग के पैमाने को देखते हुए इसमें काफी संभावनाएं हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: While the ban will redirect supply, it will not automatically create a market and ecosystem.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — जबकि प्रतिबंध आपूर्ति को पुनर्निर्देशित करेगा, यह स्वचालित रूप से एक बाजार और पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र नहीं बनाएगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Just banning export without creating an entire ecosystem will only lead to dumping of lithium-ion batteries into landfills if the blackmass has no market.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — संपूर्ण पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र बनाए बिना निर्यात पर प्रतिबंध लगाने से केवल लिथियम-आयन बैटरियों को लैंडफिल में डंप किया जाएगा यदि ब्लैकमास के पास कोई बाजार नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Blackmass production is a largely mechanical process but further downstream processing is more specialised chemical processing requiring larger investment and further policy support.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ब्लैकमास उत्पादन काफी हद तक एक यांत्रिक प्रक्रिया है लेकिन आगे की डाउनस्ट्रीम प्रसंस्करण अधिक विशिष्ट रासायनिक प्रसंस्करण है जिसके लिए बड़े निवेश और आगे नीति समर्थन की आवश्यकता होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: If downstream units are online, their output can directly feed into indigenous lithium-ion battery manufacture.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यदि डाउनस्ट्रीम इकाइयाँ ऑनलाइन हैं, तो उनका आउटपुट सीधे स्वदेशी लिथियम-आयन बैटरी निर्माण में शामिल हो सकता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Indigenous' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया। इसके Synonyms हैं: Domestic, Home-grown, Native और Antonyms हैं: Imported, Foreign, Exotic।

hinglishTracks.en: India depends heavily on imports for critical minerals such as those used in battery inputs.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — भारत बैटरी इनपुट जैसे महत्वपूर्ण खनिजों के लिए आयात पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Beyond working on supply aspects, the government must address the price gap to create a robust recycling market.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — आपूर्ति पहलुओं पर काम करने के अलावा, सरकार को एक मजबूत रीसाइक्लिंग बाजार बनाने के लिए मूल्य अंतर को भी संबोधित करना चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Under the Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022, producers buy extended producer responsibility (EPR) certificates from recyclers but these are undervalued.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — बैटरी अपशिष्ट प्रबंधन नियम, 2022 के तहत, निर्माता पुनर्चक्रणकर्ताओं से विस्तारित उत्पादक उत्तरदायित्व (ईपीआर) प्रमाणपत्र खरीदते हैं, लेकिन इनका मूल्यांकन कम किया जाता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Responsibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Cheap certificates reward recycling on paper over investment in high-yield plants.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — सस्ते प्रमाणपत्र उच्च-उपज वाले पौधों में निवेश की तुलना में कागज पर पुनर्चक्रण को पुरस्कृत करते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: A floor price that covers the full cost of recovery, with digital tracking, would fix that.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक न्यूनतम मूल्य जो डिजिटल ट्रैकिंग के साथ वसूली की पूरी लागत को कवर करता है, उसे ठीक कर देगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Rare earths show how recycling remains a missed opportunity for India because of policy gaps.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — रेयर अर्थ्स से पता चलता है कि नीतिगत खामियों के कारण रीसाइक्लिंग भारत के लिए एक गँवाया अवसर बना हुआ है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Opportunity' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अवसर — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opportunity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: A smartphone can be up to 1% neodymium-iron-boron magnet by weight.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक स्मार्टफोन वजन के हिसाब से 1% तक नियोडिमियम-आयरन-बोरॉन चुंबक का हो सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: That puts its rare earth content at about 3,000 parts per million, comparable to India’s monazite beach sands.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इससे इसकी दुर्लभ पृथ्वी सामग्री लगभग 3,000 भाग प्रति मिलियन हो जाती है, जो भारत के मोनाजाइट समुद्र तट की रेत के बराबर है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Extracting it takes less energy than mining.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसे निकालने में खनन की तुलना में कम ऊर्जा लगती है।।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #6 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Critical ban: On recycling of lithium-ion batteries

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 12:34:59 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: India needs to create an entire ecosystem for recycling of lithium-ion batteries

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: On November 10, the Directorate General of Foreign Trade banned the export of lithium-ion battery black mass by moving it from the “free” to the “prohibited” list of exports. Black mass is an intermediate product when spent batteries and factory scrap are shredded. It contains valuable lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese and graphite. The Commerce Ministry says the ban will ensure feedstock for domestic refiners, lift their capacity utilisation and draw investment. While the recycling of lead-acid batteries end-to-end is an established ecosystem and formalised, too, lithium-ion battery recycling is an emerging segment with only a few dozen licensed operators but has much potential given the scale of use of such batteries in EVs. While the ban will redirect supply, it will not automatically create a market and ecosystem. Just banning export without creating an entire ecosystem will only lead to dumping of lithium-ion batteries into landfills if the blackmass has no market. Blackmass production is a largely mechanical process but further downstream processing is more specialised chemical processing requiring larger investment and further policy support. If downstream units are online, their output can directly feed into indigenous lithium-ion battery manufacture. India depends heavily on imports for critical minerals such as those used in battery inputs. Beyond working on supply aspects, the government must address the price gap to create a robust recycling market. Under the Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022, producers buy extended producer responsibility (EPR) certificates from recyclers but these are undervalued. Cheap certificates reward recycling on paper over investment in high-yield plants. A floor price that covers the full cost of recovery, with digital tracking, would fix that. Rare earths show how recycling remains a missed opportunity for India because of policy gaps. A smartphone can be up to 1% neodymium-iron-boron magnet by weight. That puts its rare earth content at about 3,000 parts per million, comparable to India’s monazite beach sands. Extracting it takes less energy than mining. A magnet separated from the phone is about 30% rare earth. Magnets make up as much as 3% of a hard drive, but are usable only if they are removed before the drive is shredded for data destruction. Yet the e-waste rules do not require rare earth separation. Rare earths need a separate EPR category, too. Payment by weight cannot be applied for rare earth minerals.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: critical minerals / minerals / exports / economy, business and finance / business (general)

articles.title: BJP holds key party meeting in Mathura for Assembly polls
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral strategy and caste-based outreach

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior BJP leaders from Uttar Pradesh, including Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, attended a key meeting at the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Cow Research Institute in Parkham, Mathura, to discuss strategy for the upcoming U.P. Assembly polls. The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral strategy and caste-based outreach to counter the Opposition’s renewed pitch. “One goal, one idea... BJP government again for the third time... Today, in Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna, I participated in a planning meeting with National General Secretary (Organisation) B.L. Santosh, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, and BJP Uttar Pradesh Incharge Shri Vinod Tawde,” wrote Pankaj Chaudhary, U.P. BJP president, on X. “In the meeting, various important topics, including upcoming organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and providing benefits of public welfare schemes to every household, were discussed in detail. On this occasion, National General Secretary Irani, Deputy Chief Ministers Shri Keshav Prasad Maurya ji and Shri Brajesh Pathak, co-incharges of BJP Uttar Pradesh, Ministers of the State Government, public representatives, and state officials were present,” he added. State Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya said the construction of a grand temple at Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi in Mathura will be a major poll issue in the 2027 U.P. elections, and that a grand Krishna temple will be built—through the courts or mutual dialogue, as with Ayodhya. “If Akhilesh Yadav wants to join us in kar seva, we will take him along too to build a grand temple of Lord Krishna,” said the Deputy CM. The meeting in Mathura is also significant amid the BJP’s emphasis on Mathura and western Uttar Pradesh. “The BJP holds meetings regularly to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment and other issues. Reach out to various sections of society is also part of our work,” said Dinesh Dubey, a senior BJP leader based in Lucknow. Asad Rizvi, a political analyst based in Lucknow, said, “the meeting is significant as it is organised only a few months before the Assembly elections. Amid the main Opposition parties (the Samajwadi Party-Congress) pushing backwards, Scheduled Castes (SCs), Brahmins and marginalised groups through the PDA plank, the BJP will be recalibrating their policies and making a renewed effort towards them. ”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SP president Akhilesh Yadav in a cryptic statement urged the BJP leaders to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. “I request them to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. It will be auspicious. If they fall ill, call a good doctor,” said Mr. Yadav.
