🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 BJP holds key party meeting in Mathura for Assembly polls

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 04:57:22 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral strategy and caste-based outreach

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Senior BJP leaders from Uttar Pradesh, including Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, attended a key meeting at the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Cow Research Institute in Parkham, Mathura, to discuss strategy for the upcoming U.P. Assembly polls. The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral strategy and caste-based outreach to counter the Opposition’s renewed pitch. “One goal, one idea... BJP government again for the third time... Today, in Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna, I participated in a planning meeting with National General Secretary (Organisation) B.L. Santosh, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, and BJP Uttar Pradesh Incharge Shri Vinod Tawde,” wrote Pankaj Chaudhary, U.P. BJP president, on X. “In the meeting, various important topics, including upcoming organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and providing benefits of public welfare schemes to every household, were discussed in detail. On this occasion, National General Secretary Irani, Deputy Chief Ministers Shri Keshav Prasad Maurya ji and Shri Brajesh Pathak, co-incharges of BJP Uttar Pradesh, Ministers of the State Government, public representatives, and state officials were present,” he added. State Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya said the construction of a grand temple at Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi in Mathura will be a major poll issue in the 2027 U.P. elections, and that a grand Krishna temple will be built—through the courts or mutual dialogue, as with Ayodhya. “If Akhilesh Yadav wants to join us in kar seva, we will take him along too to build a grand temple of Lord Krishna,” said the Deputy CM. The meeting in Mathura is also significant amid the BJP’s emphasis on Mathura and western Uttar Pradesh. “The BJP holds meetings regularly to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment and other issues. Reach out to various sections of society is also part of our work,” said Dinesh Dubey, a senior BJP leader based in Lucknow. Asad Rizvi, a political analyst based in Lucknow, said, “the meeting is significant as it is organised only a few months before the Assembly elections. Amid the main Opposition parties (the Samajwadi Party-Congress) pushing backwards, Scheduled Castes (SCs), Brahmins and marginalised groups through the PDA plank, the BJP will be recalibrating their policies and making a renewed effort towards them. ”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SP president Akhilesh Yadav in a cryptic statement urged the BJP leaders to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. “I request them to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. It will be auspicious. If they fall ill, call a good doctor,” said Mr. Yadav.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Organisational (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Organisational' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Construction (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Construction' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Empowerment (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Empowerment' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

A. The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral...

D. The author contends that 'BJP holds key party meeting in Mathura for As' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The party announced the meeting to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and public welfare benefits, while also outlining electoral..." BJP government again for the third time... Today, in Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna, I participated in a planning meeting with National General Secretary (Organisation) B.L. Santosh, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, and BJP Uttar Pradesh Incharge Shri Vinod Tawde,” wrote Pankaj Chaudhary, U.P. BJP president, on X. “In the meeting, various important topics, including upcoming organisational programmes, booth empowerment, and providing benefits of public welfare schemes to every household, were discussed in detail. On this occasion, National General Secretary Irani, Deputy Chief Ministers Shri Keshav Prasad Maurya ji and Shri Brajesh Pathak, co-incharges of BJP Uttar Pradesh, Ministers of the State Government, public representatives, and state officials were present,” he added. State Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya said the construction of a grand temple at Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi in Mathura will be a major poll issue in the 2027 U.P. elections, and that a grand Krishna temple will be built—through the courts or mutual dialogue, as with Ayodhya. “If Akhilesh Yadav wants to join us in kar seva, we will take him along too to build a grand temple of Lord Krishna,” said the Deputy CM. The meeting in Mathura is also significant amid the BJP’s emphasis on Mathura and western Uttar Pradesh. “The BJP holds meetings regularly to discuss organisational programmes, booth empowerment and other issues. Reach out to various sections of society is also part of our work,” said Dinesh Dubey, a senior BJP leader based in Lucknow. Asad Rizvi, a political analyst based in Lucknow, said, “the meeting is significant as it is organised only a few months before the Assembly elections. Amid the main Opposition parties (the Samajwadi Party-Congress) pushing backwards, Scheduled Castes (SCs), Brahmins and marginalised groups through the PDA plank, the BJP will be recalibrating their policies and making a renewed effort towards them. ”
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The SP president Akhilesh Yadav in a cryptic statement urged the BJP leaders to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. “I request them to take a dip in the Yamuna and sip its water before starting the event. It will be auspicious. If they fall ill, call a good doctor,” said Mr. Yadav.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann said on Monday (November 16, 2026) that the greatest tribute to the 19-year-old revolutionary and freedom fighter Kartar Singh Sarabha is to fulfil his dream of a Punjab free from drugs, unemployment, and injustice. He was speaking after paying tribute to Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha on his 111th martyrdom anniversary at his native village, Sarabha, in Ludhiana district. The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision. “Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha embraced the gallows at the tender age of just 19, proving that courage, conviction and love for the motherland know no age. At a time when youngsters today are planning their futures, this great revolutionary was planning the liberation of the country. He sacrificed his youth, dreams and ultimately his life for our freedom,” he said. “On November 16, 1915, Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha was hanged at Lahore Central Jail along with six other revolutionaries in the First Lahore Conspiracy Case. His fearless commitment to the freedom of the country remains a shining example of patriotism and selflessness,” he added. As the Punjab 2027 Assembly election approaches, the drug menace has once again become a central campaign issue. In the run-up to the Assembly polls, the major political parties in the fray—the Congress, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), and the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)—are making the drug menace a key plank of their campaigns.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the ruling party has been asserting that eradicating drugs is its “biggest priority,” the Opposition parties have accused the AAP of failing to curb the drug menace and instead patronising the drug trade.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Tribute to Kartar Singh Sarabha, Punjab free from drugs and unemployment, says CM Mann

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 04:27:18 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann said on Monday (November 16, 2026) that the greatest tribute to the 19-year-old revolutionary and freedom fighter Kartar Singh Sarabha is to fulfil his dream of a Punjab free from drugs, unemployment, and injustice. He was speaking after paying tribute to Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha on his 111th martyrdom anniversary at his native village, Sarabha, in Ludhiana district. The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision. “Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha embraced the gallows at the tender age of just 19, proving that courage, conviction and love for the motherland know no age. At a time when youngsters today are planning their futures, this great revolutionary was planning the liberation of the country. He sacrificed his youth, dreams and ultimately his life for our freedom,” he said. “On November 16, 1915, Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha was hanged at Lahore Central Jail along with six other revolutionaries in the First Lahore Conspiracy Case. His fearless commitment to the freedom of the country remains a shining example of patriotism and selflessness,” he added. As the Punjab 2027 Assembly election approaches, the drug menace has once again become a central campaign issue. In the run-up to the Assembly polls, the major political parties in the fray—the Congress, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), and the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)—are making the drug menace a key plank of their campaigns.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the ruling party has been asserting that eradicating drugs is its “biggest priority,” the Opposition parties have accused the AAP of failing to curb the drug menace and instead patronising the drug trade.

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann said on Monday (November 16, 2026) that the greatest tribute to the 19-year-old revolutionary and freedom fighter Kartar Singh Sarabha is to fulfil his dream of a Punjab free from drugs, unemployment, and injustice. He was speaking after paying tribute to Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha on his 111th martyrdom anniversary at his native village, Sarabha, in Ludhiana district. The Chief Minister said his government is working to build the progressive Punjab they envision. “Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha embraced the gallows at the tender age of just 19, proving that courage, conviction and love for the motherland know no age. At a time when youngsters today are planning their futures, this great revolutionary was planning the liberation of the country. He sacrificed his youth, dreams and ultimately his life for our freedom,” he said. “On November 16, 1915, Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha was hanged at Lahore Central Jail along with six other revolutionaries in the First Lahore Conspiracy Case. His fearless commitment to the freedom of the country remains a shining example of patriotism and selflessness,” he added. As the Punjab 2027 Assembly election approaches, the drug menace has once again become a central campaign issue. In the run-up to the Assembly polls, the major political parties in the fray—the Congress, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), and the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)—are making the drug menace a key plank of their campaigns.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While the ruling party has been asserting that eradicating drugs is its “biggest priority,” the Opposition parties have accused the AAP of failing to curb the drug menace and instead patronising the drug trade.

articles.title: Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress’ Karra, BJP’s Parihar spark protests in J&K
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Karra said that “two SPOs were killed by the Army in a mistaken-identity case on November 11”, while senior BJP leader Sharma said, “Congress is spreading misleading information to shift blame from terrorists to security forces”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two separate remarks made by J&K Pradesh Congress Committee (JKPCC) president Tariq Hameed Karra and BJP legislator Shagun Parihar in the aftermath of the killing of two Special Police Officers (SPOs) in Kishtwar on Monday (November 16, 2026) sparked protests from different quarters. In response to the statement by Mr. Karra that “two SPOs were killed reportedly by the Army in a mistaken identity case on November 11”, senior BJP leader and Leader of Opposition (LoP) Sunil Sharma said, “The Congress is spreading misleading information to shift the blame from terrorists to our security forces. The SPOs were on duty and travelling to an Army post at Dharna-Marwah to relieve the jawans posted there. Calling two martyrs hunters is an insult to their sacrifice and to their grieving families.” He demanded that Mr. Karra “immediately withdraw the remarks and apologise to the martyrs’ families, the J&K Police and the Indian Army”. Scores of members of the BJP and BJP-affiliated organisations held street protests against Mr. Karra and the Congress in Jammu. Members of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) also burn an effigy of Mr. Karra as a mark of protest. BJYM leader Arun Prabhat, while condemning the statement of Mr. Karra, said, “It shows the hearts of Congress beat for Pakistan. The conspirators should face action. In case of any role of mosques, such places too should face action.” Mr. Prabhat was seconding the controversial remarks of Ms. Parihar of the BJP, who claimed “announcements were made from the mosques in Kishtwar’s Dachhan area to identify the targets” allegedly ahead of the killings of two SPOs on November 11. However, several religious organisations, including the Anjuman Islamia Bhaderwah and Kishtwar, in the Chenab Valley condemned the statement of Ms. Parihar and denied any role of mosques in the latest attack on the policemen. Ruling National Conference (NC) legislator Tanvir Sadiq said the BJP must be “held accountable for its MLA’s deeply irresponsible and inflammatory allegations against a mosque in Jammu”. “Making communal allegations in the aftermath of a tragic killing is utterly unacceptable. The BJP leadership cannot hide behind silence or pretend this is an isolated matter. It must unequivocally condemn these remarks and issue an unconditional public apology. Stop playing with the communal harmony of J&K,” said Mr. Sadiq. A spokesman of the All J&K Shia Association said the organisation “strongly condemn Ms. Parihar’s attempt to drag a mosque into the tragic killing of our brave SPOs”. “Terrorists are enemies of all humanity and terrorism has no religion. Unsubstantiated claims against a place of worship only weaken our fight against terror,” said the Association.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress’ Karra, BJP’s Parihar spark protests in J&K

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 03:36:43 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Mr. Karra said that “two SPOs were killed by the Army in a mistaken-identity case on November 11”, while senior BJP leader Sharma said, “Congress is spreading misleading information to shift blame from terrorists to security forces”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two separate remarks made by J&K Pradesh Congress Committee (JKPCC) president Tariq Hameed Karra and BJP legislator Shagun Parihar in the aftermath of the killing of two Special Police Officers (SPOs) in Kishtwar on Monday (November 16, 2026) sparked protests from different quarters. In response to the statement by Mr. Karra that “two SPOs were killed reportedly by the Army in a mistaken identity case on November 11”, senior BJP leader and Leader of Opposition (LoP) Sunil Sharma said, “The Congress is spreading misleading information to shift the blame from terrorists to our security forces. The SPOs were on duty and travelling to an Army post at Dharna-Marwah to relieve the jawans posted there. Calling two martyrs hunters is an insult to their sacrifice and to their grieving families.” He demanded that Mr. Karra “immediately withdraw the remarks and apologise to the martyrs’ families, the J&K Police and the Indian Army”. Scores of members of the BJP and BJP-affiliated organisations held street protests against Mr. Karra and the Congress in Jammu. Members of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) also burn an effigy of Mr. Karra as a mark of protest. BJYM leader Arun Prabhat, while condemning the statement of Mr. Karra, said, “It shows the hearts of Congress beat for Pakistan. The conspirators should face action. In case of any role of mosques, such places too should face action.” Mr. Prabhat was seconding the controversial remarks of Ms. Parihar of the BJP, who claimed “announcements were made from the mosques in Kishtwar’s Dachhan area to identify the targets” allegedly ahead of the killings of two SPOs on November 11. However, several religious organisations, including the Anjuman Islamia Bhaderwah and Kishtwar, in the Chenab Valley condemned the statement of Ms. Parihar and denied any role of mosques in the latest attack on the policemen. Ruling National Conference (NC) legislator Tanvir Sadiq said the BJP must be “held accountable for its MLA’s deeply irresponsible and inflammatory allegations against a mosque in Jammu”. “Making communal allegations in the aftermath of a tragic killing is utterly unacceptable. The BJP leadership cannot hide behind silence or pretend this is an isolated matter. It must unequivocally condemn these remarks and issue an unconditional public apology. Stop playing with the communal harmony of J&K,” said Mr. Sadiq. A spokesman of the All J&K Shia Association said the organisation “strongly condemn Ms. Parihar’s attempt to drag a mosque into the tragic killing of our brave SPOs”. “Terrorists are enemies of all humanity and terrorism has no religion. Unsubstantiated claims against a place of worship only weaken our fight against terror,” said the Association.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Jammu and Kashmir / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress’ Karra, BJP’s Parihar spark protests in J&K", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Karra said that “two SPOs were killed by the Army in a mistaken-identity case on November 11”, while senior BJP leader Sharma said, “Congress is...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congr' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congr' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Karra said that “two SPOs were killed by the Army in a mistaken-identity case on November 11”, while senior BJP leader Sharma said, “Congress is..." (Hinglish Arth: कर्रा ने कहा कि “11 नवंबर को गलत पहचान के मामले में सेना ने दो एसपीओ को मार डाला”, जबकि वरिष्ठ भाजपा नेता शर्मा ने कहा, “कांग्रेस आतंकवादियों से सुरक्षा पर दोष मढ़ने के लिए भ्रामक जानकारी फैला रही है।”)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Kishtwar killings aftermath: Remarks by Congress’ Karra, BJP’s Parihar spark protests in J&K"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Jammu and Kashmir / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Jammu and Kashmir / Indian National Congress / Bharatiya Janata Party." (Hinglish Arth: जम्मू और कश्मीर / भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस / भारतीय जनता पार्टी)

articles.title: Christian community seeks West Bengal CM’s intervention over targeted attacks ahead of Christmas
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Bishop of Calcutta Reverend Paritosh Canning ruled out claims of religious conversion by institutions affiliated with the Churches of North India

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Ahead of the upcoming Christmas festivities, the representatives of Christian communities in West Bengal have expressed concerns about the rising attacks on churches across several districts in the State and have sought intervention from Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari. During a press conference addressed by the Bengal Christian Council (a cluster body for Protestant churches), the Bishop of Calcutta, Reverend Paritosh Canning, said that the concerns of the people of the community are not without reason. “West Bengal has traditionally been a land of communal harmony, where people belonging to different faiths and communities have coexisted in peace, mutual respect, and brotherhood. With Christmas approaching, the apprehensions of the Christian community have become particularly serious. However, the prevailing atmosphere of insecurity has raised genuine concerns about whether Christians will be able to observe their religious services and celebrate festivals without fear or disruption,” the bishop said, speaking to media persons. He added that such incidents have increased since the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) government came to power in West Bengal in May 2026. Attacks have been reported across several districts in South Bengal, on both banks of the Hooghly River, including South 24 Parganas, North 24 Parganas, Purba Medinipur, and Paschim Medinipur, among others. Bishop Canning said that there are allegations of religious conversions in the churches, adding that “we can confirm that no conversion takes place at the churches operating under the Churches of North India.” “All the minority communities used to live peacefully under the previous governments. However, it is not clear who the attackers are or why they are doing this,” he said. In another development, representatives of Bangiya Christiya Pariseba (BCP) held a meeting in response to remarks by West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya. The State BJP president had on Sunday said that religious conversions are taking place across districts in West Bengal and issued a warning to Christian missionary schools in the State, claiming that they are targeting teachers wearing saffron sarees. The Archbishop of Calcutta (Roman Catholic), Reverend Elius Frank, also participated in a meeting organised by BCP, though he did not speak to the media. In a letter addressed to Samik Bhattacharya, Herod Mullick, the founder-secretary of BCP, said that “if any institution or individual is found guilty of illegal or forced religious conversion through greed or deception, we strongly condemn such actions and stand firmly against them.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “However, making broad, unsubstantiated generalisations without naming specific individuals or institutions unfairly casts a shadow of suspicion over the entire Christian community and the more than 800 educational institutions we operate across West Bengal,” the letter added.

However, it is not clear who the attackers are or why they are doing this,” he said. In another development, representatives of Bangiya Christiya Pariseba (BCP) held a meeting in response to remarks by West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya. articles.title: West Bengal BJP supporters beating up own party members, says Union Minister as feuds rise in party
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: “BJP workers are being beaten up, and those beating them are also from the BJP. The police administration has turned a blind eye and is not functioning impartially,” alleged Bongaon MP Santanu Thakur

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Amid reports of growing feuds within the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in West Bengal , Union Minister of State and Bongaon MP Shantanu Thakur not only publicly acknowledged factionalism within the party but also said that BJP supporters are attacked by its members. The Minister spoke about developments in his own constituency in North 24 Parganas, but reports of factional feuds within the BJP rank and file have surfaced across the State. “Here, BJP workers are being beaten up, and those beating them are also from the BJP. The police administration has turned a blind eye and is not functioning impartially,” Mr. Thakur, who is the Bongaon MP and also a prominent leader of the Matua community, alleged. The Minister, who hails from Thakurbari and is the religious head of the Matua community, said that divisions are emerging within the party, resulting in major problems. Differences between Shantanu Thakur, the Bongaon North MLA, and State Food and Civil Supplies Minister Ashok Kirtania have been going around in political circles. On Sunday, BJP’s Panihati MLA Ratna Debnath, while expressing condolences over the death of a BJP worker, said that it would have been better “had the BJP not come to power in the State.” Arup Saha, husband of Ruma Saha—the secretary of BJP’s Panihati-1 Mandal (zone)—was attacked on Saturday (November 14, 2026), by a mob that allegedly included some of the party’s supporters. Saha succumbed to his injuries on Sunday. Reports of an intra-party feud have surfaced between long-time supporters of the ruling party in the State and former Trinamool Congress supporters who switched allegiance after the Assembly election results in May 2026. Political observers say that the majority of the BJP leadership, including Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari, had joined the party about five to six years ago.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: State BJP president Samik Bhattacharya has repeatedly said that the doors of the party are closed for Trinamool supporters who want to join. Mr. Bhattacharya said that an FIR should be registered against elements who are trying to associate with the party and tarnish its image. “Register FIRs. Suvendu Adhikari is the police minister. Give me the papers; I will file them,” Mr. Bhattacharya said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 West Bengal BJP supporters beating up own party members, says Union Minister as feuds rise in party

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 02:28:28 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: “BJP workers are being beaten up, and those beating them are also from the BJP. The police administration has turned a blind eye and is not functioning impartially,” alleged Bongaon MP Santanu Thakur

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Amid reports of growing feuds within the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in West Bengal , Union Minister of State and Bongaon MP Shantanu Thakur not only publicly acknowledged factionalism within the party but also said that BJP supporters are attacked by its members. The Minister spoke about developments in his own constituency in North 24 Parganas, but reports of factional feuds within the BJP rank and file have surfaced across the State. “Here, BJP workers are being beaten up, and those beating them are also from the BJP. The police administration has turned a blind eye and is not functioning impartially,” Mr. Thakur, who is the Bongaon MP and also a prominent leader of the Matua community, alleged. The Minister, who hails from Thakurbari and is the religious head of the Matua community, said that divisions are emerging within the party, resulting in major problems. Differences between Shantanu Thakur, the Bongaon North MLA, and State Food and Civil Supplies Minister Ashok Kirtania have been going around in political circles. On Sunday, BJP’s Panihati MLA Ratna Debnath, while expressing condolences over the death of a BJP worker, said that it would have been better “had the BJP not come to power in the State.” Arup Saha, husband of Ruma Saha—the secretary of BJP’s Panihati-1 Mandal (zone)—was attacked on Saturday (November 14, 2026), by a mob that allegedly included some of the party’s supporters. Saha succumbed to his injuries on Sunday. Reports of an intra-party feud have surfaced between long-time supporters of the ruling party in the State and former Trinamool Congress supporters who switched allegiance after the Assembly election results in May 2026. Political observers say that the majority of the BJP leadership, including Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari, had joined the party about five to six years ago.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: State BJP president Samik Bhattacharya has repeatedly said that the doors of the party are closed for Trinamool supporters who want to join. Mr. Bhattacharya said that an FIR should be registered against elements who are trying to associate with the party and tarnish its image. “Register FIRs. Suvendu Adhikari is the police minister. Give me the papers; I will file them,” Mr. Bhattacharya said.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Administration (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Allegiance (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Allegiance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Factional (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Factional' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "West Bengal BJP supporters beating up own party members, says Union Minister as feuds rise in party", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. “BJP workers are being beaten up, and those beating them are also from the BJP.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'West Bengal BJP supporters beating up own party ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'West Bengal BJP supporters beating up own par' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'West Bengal BJP supporters beating up own par' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "“BJP workers are being beaten up, and those beating them are also from the BJP." (Hinglish Arth: “भाजपा कार्यकर्ताओं को पीटा जा रहा है, और उन्हें पीटने वाले भी भाजपा से हैं।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "West Bengal BJP supporters beating up own party members, says Union Minister as feuds rise in party"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Give me the papers; I will file them,” Mr.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Give me the papers; I will file them,” Mr." (Hinglish Arth: मुझे कागजात दो; मैं उन्हें दाखिल करूंगा,'' श्रीमान।)

articles.title: Site inspection held for key Goshree-Mamangalam traffic corridor in Keralam’s Kochi
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Developing the stretch into a major traffic corridor is expected to help resolve the city’s persistent traffic bottlenecks to a great extent and ease the existing pressure on several roads

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: People’s representatives and officials on Monday conducted a site inspection for the proposed Goshree-Mamangalam road development project, which is expected to provide major relief from traffic woes in Kochi. The project is critical to improving the overall traffic system in the city and enhancing connectivity between various points. The demand for the proposed road dates back more than 30 years. Developing this stretch into a major traffic corridor is expected to help resolve the city’s persistent traffic bottlenecks to a great extent and ease the existing pressure on several roads. A sum of ₹1 crore was earmarked for the development of Goshree Bridge and Goshree-Mamangalam Road in the last State Budget following interventions by Hibi Eden MP, MLAs T.J. Vinod and Uma Thomas, and Mayor V.K. Minimol. The allocation was intended for conducting a traffic study, demarcating the alignment, and completing the survey. An action plan will be formulated based on scientific studies and survey findings. Initially, the Goshree-Mamangalam road was proposed to be developed at 22 metres. However, during the tenure of the previous Kochi Corporation council, the width was scaled down to 15 metres in the 2024 Master Plan, which was subsequently approved by the State government. Based on this, follow-up measures are now being planned. Coordination among various departments is essential, as several roads within the Kochi Corporation limits form part of the project. Accordingly, the PWD (Roads) will be entrusted with conducting the traffic study, carrying out the survey and preparing a detailed project report. This is expected to facilitate the efficient and time-bound execution of the project through coordinated efforts by the Corporation and the PWD. The delegation assessed the existing condition of roads proposed to be included in the project, nature of traffic movement, development potential, and the role of the departments concerned. This is expected to aid the coordination of the proposed traffic study, survey, and subsequent follow-up measures.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: MLAs T.J. Vinod and Uma Thomas, Mayor V.K. Minimol, and deputy mayor V.R. Sudheer were among those who participated in the inspection.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Site inspection held for key Goshree-Mamangalam traffic corridor in Keralam’s Kochi

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 01:53:24 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Developing the stretch into a major traffic corridor is expected to help resolve the city’s persistent traffic bottlenecks to a great extent and ease the existing pressure on several roads

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: People’s representatives and officials on Monday conducted a site inspection for the proposed Goshree-Mamangalam road development project, which is expected to provide major relief from traffic woes in Kochi. The project is critical to improving the overall traffic system in the city and enhancing connectivity between various points. The demand for the proposed road dates back more than 30 years. Developing this stretch into a major traffic corridor is expected to help resolve the city’s persistent traffic bottlenecks to a great extent and ease the existing pressure on several roads. A sum of ₹1 crore was earmarked for the development of Goshree Bridge and Goshree-Mamangalam Road in the last State Budget following interventions by Hibi Eden MP, MLAs T.J. Vinod and Uma Thomas, and Mayor V.K. Minimol. The allocation was intended for conducting a traffic study, demarcating the alignment, and completing the survey. An action plan will be formulated based on scientific studies and survey findings. Initially, the Goshree-Mamangalam road was proposed to be developed at 22 metres. However, during the tenure of the previous Kochi Corporation council, the width was scaled down to 15 metres in the 2024 Master Plan, which was subsequently approved by the State government. Based on this, follow-up measures are now being planned. Coordination among various departments is essential, as several roads within the Kochi Corporation limits form part of the project. Accordingly, the PWD (Roads) will be entrusted with conducting the traffic study, carrying out the survey and preparing a detailed project report. This is expected to facilitate the efficient and time-bound execution of the project through coordinated efforts by the Corporation and the PWD. The delegation assessed the existing condition of roads proposed to be included in the project, nature of traffic movement, development potential, and the role of the departments concerned. This is expected to aid the coordination of the proposed traffic study, survey, and subsequent follow-up measures.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: MLAs T.J. Vinod and Uma Thomas, Mayor V.K. Minimol, and deputy mayor V.R. Sudheer were among those who participated in the inspection.

articles.title: A poverty line that falls short
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Reliable poverty estimates are not just for academic purposes. India has made real progress, but without a credible benchmark, it is hard to say how much, or how much remains to be done

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: There is no serious doubt that poverty in India has fallen sharply over the past decade. However, researchers and policymakers cannot agree on how many are still poor. Depending on the estimate, the share ranges from about 5% to more than 26%. Take the recent World Bank report. At its international line of $3 a day (2021 PPP), 2.6% of Indians were poor in 2022-23. Raise the line to $4.20, the bank’s benchmark for lower middle-income countries, and the figure jumps to around 16.1%. Same country, same year. Only the yardstick changed. A low level of extreme poverty does not necessarily mean poverty is not still a major issue. Where you draw the line decides how much economic insecurity you see.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India’s own figures tell a similar convoluted story. For example, SBI Research (2025) takes the Tendulkar line of 2009, adjusts it for inflation, and gets poverty of 7.2% in rural India and 4.6% in urban India for 2022-23. Rangarajan and Dev (2014), using an inflation-adjusted version of the Rangarajan Committee line, arrive at 10.8%. Further, Sethu, Surya and Ruthu (2024), who rebuild the Rangarajan method from the latest consumption survey, report 26.4%. Most of that gap boils down to the lines themselves: SBI’s Tendulkar-based lines use, after adjusting for inflation, about ₹1,632 a month per person in rural areas and ₹1,944 in urban areas. In contrast, Sethu et al. use much higher thresholds of ₹2,515 and ₹3,639. And the outcomes are obvious: Higher lines, higher poverty. Method matters too. One camp takes an old line and adjusts it for inflation. The other reconstructs the line from spending patterns in the new survey. Both have limitations, and they are answering different questions.

hinglishTracks.en: Reliable poverty estimates are not just for academic purposes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — विश्वसनीय गरीबी अनुमान केवल शैक्षणिक उद्देश्यों के लिए नहीं हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: India has made real progress, but without a credible benchmark, it is hard to say how much, or how much remains to be done
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — भारत ने वास्तविक प्रगति की है, लेकिन किसी विश्वसनीय बेंचमार्क के बिना, यह कहना मुश्किल है कि कितना, या कितना किया जाना बाकी है।

hinglishTracks.en: There is no serious doubt that poverty in India has fallen sharply over the past decade.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसमें कोई संदेह नहीं है कि पिछले एक दशक में भारत में गरीबी तेजी से घटी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, researchers and policymakers cannot agree on how many are still poor.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हालाँकि, शोधकर्ता और नीति निर्माता इस बात पर सहमत नहीं हो सकते कि कितने लोग अभी भी गरीब हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Depending on the estimate, the share ranges from about 5% to more than 26%.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अनुमान के आधार पर, हिस्सेदारी लगभग 5% से लेकर 26% से अधिक तक होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Take the recent World Bank report.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — विश्व बैंक की हालिया रिपोर्ट लीजिए.।

hinglishTracks.en: At its international line of $3 a day (2021 PPP), 2.6% of Indians were poor in 2022-23.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — प्रतिदिन 3 डॉलर (2021 पीपीपी) की इसकी अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा पर, 2022-23 में 2.6% भारतीय गरीब थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अंतरराष्ट्रीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'International' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Raise the line to $4.20, the bank’s benchmark for lower middle-income countries, and the figure jumps to around 16.1%.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — निम्न मध्यम आय वाले देशों के लिए बैंक का बेंचमार्क, इस सीमा को $4.20 तक बढ़ाएं, और यह आंकड़ा लगभग 16.1% तक पहुंच जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Same country, same year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — वही देश, वही साल.।

hinglishTracks.en: Only the yardstick changed.

hinglishTracks.en: For example, SBI Research (2025) takes the Tendulkar line of 2009, adjusts it for inflation, and gets poverty of 7.2% in rural India and 4.6% in urban India for 2022-23.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #14 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 A poverty line that falls short

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 10:29:13 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Reliable poverty estimates are not just for academic purposes. India has made real progress, but without a credible benchmark, it is hard to say how much, or how much remains to be done

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: There is no serious doubt that poverty in India has fallen sharply over the past decade. However, researchers and policymakers cannot agree on how many are still poor. Depending on the estimate, the share ranges from about 5% to more than 26%. Take the recent World Bank report. At its international line of $3 a day (2021 PPP), 2.6% of Indians were poor in 2022-23. Raise the line to $4.20, the bank’s benchmark for lower middle-income countries, and the figure jumps to around 16.1%. Same country, same year. Only the yardstick changed. A low level of extreme poverty does not necessarily mean poverty is not still a major issue. Where you draw the line decides how much economic insecurity you see.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India’s own figures tell a similar convoluted story. For example, SBI Research (2025) takes the Tendulkar line of 2009, adjusts it for inflation, and gets poverty of 7.2% in rural India and 4.6% in urban India for 2022-23. Rangarajan and Dev (2014), using an inflation-adjusted version of the Rangarajan Committee line, arrive at 10.8%. Further, Sethu, Surya and Ruthu (2024), who rebuild the Rangarajan method from the latest consumption survey, report 26.4%. Most of that gap boils down to the lines themselves: SBI’s Tendulkar-based lines use, after adjusting for inflation, about ₹1,632 a month per person in rural areas and ₹1,944 in urban areas. In contrast, Sethu et al. use much higher thresholds of ₹2,515 and ₹3,639. And the outcomes are obvious: Higher lines, higher poverty. Method matters too. One camp takes an old line and adjusts it for inflation. The other reconstructs the line from spending patterns in the new survey. Both have limitations, and they are answering different questions.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Inflation (Noun)
महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए।
✓ Syn: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness  |  ✖ Ant: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession
International (Adjective)
अंतरराष्ट्रीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'International' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Consumption (Noun)
उपभोग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consumption' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Insecurity (Adjective / Verb)
असुरक्षा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Insecurity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "A poverty line that falls short", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Reliable poverty estimates are not just for academic purposes.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'A poverty line that falls short' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'A poverty line that falls short' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'A poverty line that falls short' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Reliable poverty estimates are not just for academic purposes." (Hinglish Arth: विश्वसनीय गरीबी अनुमान केवल शैक्षणिक उद्देश्यों के लिए नहीं हैं।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "A poverty line that falls short"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Both have limitations, and they are answering different questions.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Both have limitations, and they are answering different questions." (Hinglish Arth: दोनों की सीमाएँ हैं, और वे अलग-अलग प्रश्नों का उत्तर दे रहे हैं।)

articles.title: Customers at some of the U.S.’ largest banks are reporting difficulty accessing accounts online
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Bank of America, Chase, J.P. Morgan, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo and Zelle were listed by users as down or experiencing issues, according to the website downdetector.com

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Customers reported difficulty accessing the online accounts at some of the U.S.’ largest banks on Monday (November 16, 2026). Bank of America, Chase, J.P. Morgan, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo and Zelle were listed by users as down or experiencing issues, according to the website downdetector.com. Chase Bank’s services are experiencing a technical bug issue, not a cyber issue, a spokesperson said Monday (November 16, 2026). “Due to a technical issue, some transactions are taking longer than usual to complete but customers still have access to their accounts and funds,” a Chase spokesperson said in a statement. “We are working to resolve this as quickly as possible.” The reports follow a major outage by Microsoft that began on Friday (November 13, 2026) and lasted for hours, which impacted services including Outlook, Teams and the AI assistant Copilot.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Some Chase customers received a message that said, “Some services aren’t available. We’re working on them. Please try back later.”

Bank of America, Chase, J.P. Morgan, U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo and Zelle were listed by users as down or experiencing issues, according to the website downdetector.com. articles.title: Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you need to know
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Cyclone Akvan may intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A weather system brewing over the Bay of Bengal has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm on Monday evening (November 16, 2026), according to the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD). It is moving north-northwestwards towards Andhra Pradesh at 10 kmph and has been named ‘Akvan’, a name suggested by Iran under the North Indian Ocean naming list. CS Akvan over central adj westcentral BoB at 0530IST 17 Nov 610km E of Chennai 630km NE of Trincomalee 660km SE of Machilipatnam 670km SSE of Visakhapatnam 790km S of Gopalpur. Likely SCS today VSCS on 19th. Crossing AP coast as VSCS on 20th Nov. https://t.co/Qc2SeQNUPU It originated as a well-marked low-pressure area over the southeast Bay of Bengal on Saturday (November 14, 2026), the system intensified into a depression by Sunday (November 15, 2026) morning. The storm may continue to move north-northwestwards and intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026) evening and may cross the A.P. coast around noon on November 20, as a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm, with windspeed gusting to 145 kmph, similar to that of Arnab. The system is forecast to bypass Tamil Nadu and move toward the Andhra Pradesh coast around November 19, 2026, also impacting Odisha. ALSO WATCH Odisha braces for possible third cyclone in three weeks as Bay of Bengal system intensifies Heavy rainfall warnings have been issued for coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Andaman and Nicobar Islands through November 20, 2026. In West Bengal, heavy rain is forecast for South 24 Parganas and Purba Medinipur from November 19 to 21, 2026, with downpour likely in the southern districts of Howrah, Paschim Medinipur and Jhargram on November 20 and 21. According to the IMD, thunderstorms, accompanied with winds up to 40 kmph in Kolkata and most districts of Gangetic West Bengal is also likely. A nip in the air over South Bengal is likely to dissipate as day and night temperatures will rise by two to three degrees Celsius from November 18, 2026, it said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Cyclone Akvan is expected to cause rains in north coastal districts in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal area, it said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you need to know

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 10:50:55 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Cyclone Akvan may intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026)

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A weather system brewing over the Bay of Bengal has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm on Monday evening (November 16, 2026), according to the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD). It is moving north-northwestwards towards Andhra Pradesh at 10 kmph and has been named ‘Akvan’, a name suggested by Iran under the North Indian Ocean naming list. CS Akvan over central adj westcentral BoB at 0530IST 17 Nov 610km E of Chennai 630km NE of Trincomalee 660km SE of Machilipatnam 670km SSE of Visakhapatnam 790km S of Gopalpur. Likely SCS today VSCS on 19th. Crossing AP coast as VSCS on 20th Nov. https://t.co/Qc2SeQNUPU It originated as a well-marked low-pressure area over the southeast Bay of Bengal on Saturday (November 14, 2026), the system intensified into a depression by Sunday (November 15, 2026) morning. The storm may continue to move north-northwestwards and intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026) evening and may cross the A.P. coast around noon on November 20, as a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm, with windspeed gusting to 145 kmph, similar to that of Arnab. The system is forecast to bypass Tamil Nadu and move toward the Andhra Pradesh coast around November 19, 2026, also impacting Odisha. ALSO WATCH Odisha braces for possible third cyclone in three weeks as Bay of Bengal system intensifies Heavy rainfall warnings have been issued for coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Andaman and Nicobar Islands through November 20, 2026. In West Bengal, heavy rain is forecast for South 24 Parganas and Purba Medinipur from November 19 to 21, 2026, with downpour likely in the southern districts of Howrah, Paschim Medinipur and Jhargram on November 20 and 21. According to the IMD, thunderstorms, accompanied with winds up to 40 kmph in Kolkata and most districts of Gangetic West Bengal is also likely. A nip in the air over South Bengal is likely to dissipate as day and night temperatures will rise by two to three degrees Celsius from November 18, 2026, it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Cyclone Akvan is expected to cause rains in north coastal districts in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal area, it said.

Meteorological (Adjective)
मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts).
✓ Syn: Atmospheric, Climatic, Weather-related  |  ✖ Ant: Geological, Subterranean, Terrestrial
Westcentral (Adjective)
पश्चिम मध्य — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Westcentral' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Department (Adjective)
विभाग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Department' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Depression (Adjective / Verb)
अवसाद — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Depression' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you need to know", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Cyclone Akvan may intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026).
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What you' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'Cyclone Akvan brews over Bay of Bengal: What ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Cyclone Akvan may intensify into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over westcentral Bay of Bengal by Tuesday (November 17, 2026)." articles.title: Why is Telangana merging its Board of Intermediate Education with Department of School Education? | Explained
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Under the proposed structure, nursery to Class 4 will form the primary stage, Classes 5 to 8 the secondary, and Classes 9 to 12 the senior secondary, as in several other States

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Telangana plans to integrate Intermediate education into the school system from the 2027–28 academic year, bringing Classes 11 and 12 under a unified framework. Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy announced the proposal during a review meeting on November 11 and directed officials to implement the restructuring.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 ASEAN Summit LIVE updates: PM Modi to participate in ASEAN-India Summit; Quad meeting likely after President Trump arrives

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 12:28:10 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In the first Quad Summit since 2024, PM Modi is expected to meet U.S. President Trump, Japanese PM Takaichi and Australian PM Albanese

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: As Chinese President Xi Jinping and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney met ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders’ summit today, both the countries have called for deeper ties as Ottawa navigates strained relations with the United States and seeks closer cooperation with Beijing. Read more: Xi, Carney call for deeper ties as Canada looks beyond U.S. for trade Canada-Chi Jn: Xi and Carney push deeper ties amid shifting US-Canada trade, noting rising predictability and a tariff-reducing EV agreement. Canada-Chi Jn: Xi and Carney push deeper ties amid shifting US-Canada trade, noting rising predictability and a tariff-reducing EV agreement. PM Modi stated that the Act East Policy has given fresh momentum and depth to India-ASEAN relations. “In our collaboration, India’s commitment to ASEAN’s unity and centrality is and will remain unwavering,’ he added. “India, ASEAN represent around one-fourth of global population; it is important to decide our future by cooperation; not by competition,” PM Modi said in the India-ASEAN Summit in Manila today. “We believe that India’s development and ASEAN’s prosperity are deeply interconnected,” he added. The Embassy of India in Manila will resume all regular consular services, passport applications and visa processing from Wednesday, following a temporary suspension in view of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and East Asia Summit. According to the earlier advisory, the closure was in accordance with Proclamation No. 1447 issued by the Government of the Republic of the Philippines, declaring special non-working days in the National Capital Region (NCR) for the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Joint Statement of the 29th ASEAN-Japan Summit on Realising Economic Resilience was adopted today in Manila, with the meeting being attended by the Leaders of ASEAN Member States, the Prime Minister of Japan H.E. Sanae Takaichi, and Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn.

✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Collaboration (Noun)
सहयोग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Collaboration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: SCBA seeks contempt action against lawyer for derogatory remarks about CJI
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The office bearers urged the court to tag the petition along with pending contempt pleas against journalist Nikhil Wagle and Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Raut, who are also facing contempt proceedings for allegedly making derogatory online remarks against the CJI

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) on Tuesday (November 17, 2026) conveyed to the Supreme Court its intention to seek contempt action against a lawyer who made deprecatory remarks about Chief Justice of India Surya Kant in open court on Monday (November 16, 2026). SCBA secretary Praghya Baghel and joint secretary Meenesh Dubey made an oral mentioning before the CJI that Attorney General R. Venkataramani had already given the necessary statutory consent to file the contempt petition against the lawyer. The office bearers urged the court to tag the petition along with pending contempt pleas against journalist Nikhil Wagle and Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Raut, who are also facing contempt proceedings for allegedly making derogatory online remarks against the CJI. The petitions against Mr. Raut and Mr. Wagle is listed for hearing on Tuesday (November 17, 2026). The SCBA office bearers said they had recordings of the same lawyer making unsavoury remarks against the CJI on previous occasions too. The CJI agreed to list the petition, if all procedural necessities were completed, on November 18.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The CJI had refused the leaders’ request for audience on the grounds of judicial propriety and had asked them to file a petition on the judicial side. They had subsequently filed a writ petition seeking an independent probe into allegations of arbitrary use of power by Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

articles.title: Gas leak at ONGC well in Andhra’s Konaseema; residents within 1 km alerted, road closed
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: There is no blowout or fire so far, officials say; experts are on their way to plug the leak

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A major gas leak has been reported from Well-7 operated by the Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) near Nagaram in Maamidikuduru mandal in Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema district, Andhra Pradesh , forcing people within a one-kilometre radius to leave their villages to avoid any loss of life. The gas began to leak during drilling early on Tuesday (November 17, 2026). An official associated with the crisis management team told The Hindu: “The gas leak has been reported during the drilling activity. However, there is no blowout of gas. People within one kilometer radius have been alerted.” Water is sprayed on ONGC's Well-7 near Nagaram in Andhra Pradesh's Konaseema district to cool the site after a gas leak on Tuesday. Residents within 1 km have been moved out; officials say there is no blowout or fire so far. Video: Special Arrangement https://t.co/mlgu7MUKFl The ONGC’s crisis management team has rushed to the spot, where an attempt is being made to cap the well while cooling the well site to prevent a blowout. Vehicular movement on the Maamidikuduru-Razole road has been blocked as a precautionary measure. District Collector R. Mahesh Kumar has rushed to the spot and appealed to people living around the site to be alert about the gas leak and be prepared to leave their homes if an emergency is declared. Meanwhile, Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu enquired about the gas leak with officials and asked them to take measures to control the leakage. Officials informed the Chief Minister that the gas began leaking around 4.30 a.m., accompanied by a loud noise, and was gushing out with great force. Mr. Naidu directed officials to evacuate the residents in the affected areas to safer locations. He said public safety must be given the highest priority and asked the ONGC to deploy specialised technical teams to take immediate action to contain the leak. Noting that such incidents had occurred frequently of late, the Chief Minister instructed officials to immediately take up the issue with the ONGC representatives. Mr. Naidu ordered a review of safety protocols in consultation with the ONGC Chairman and other senior officials of the organisation.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Officials told the Chief Minister that residents living within a one-kilometre radius of the gas well had been evacuated. ONGC officials said there was no fire so far and that the wellhead remained secure.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 Gas leak at ONGC well in Andhra’s Konaseema; residents within 1 km alerted, road closed

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 12:25:53 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: There is no blowout or fire so far, officials say; experts are on their way to plug the leak

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A major gas leak has been reported from Well-7 operated by the Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) near Nagaram in Maamidikuduru mandal in Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema district, Andhra Pradesh , forcing people within a one-kilometre radius to leave their villages to avoid any loss of life. The gas began to leak during drilling early on Tuesday (November 17, 2026). An official associated with the crisis management team told The Hindu: “The gas leak has been reported during the drilling activity. However, there is no blowout of gas. People within one kilometer radius have been alerted.” Water is sprayed on ONGC's Well-7 near Nagaram in Andhra Pradesh's Konaseema district to cool the site after a gas leak on Tuesday. Residents within 1 km have been moved out; officials say there is no blowout or fire so far. Video: Special Arrangement https://t.co/mlgu7MUKFl The ONGC’s crisis management team has rushed to the spot, where an attempt is being made to cap the well while cooling the well site to prevent a blowout. Vehicular movement on the Maamidikuduru-Razole road has been blocked as a precautionary measure. District Collector R. Mahesh Kumar has rushed to the spot and appealed to people living around the site to be alert about the gas leak and be prepared to leave their homes if an emergency is declared. Meanwhile, Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu enquired about the gas leak with officials and asked them to take measures to control the leakage. Officials informed the Chief Minister that the gas began leaking around 4.30 a.m., accompanied by a loud noise, and was gushing out with great force. Mr. Naidu directed officials to evacuate the residents in the affected areas to safer locations. He said public safety must be given the highest priority and asked the ONGC to deploy specialised technical teams to take immediate action to contain the leak. Noting that such incidents had occurred frequently of late, the Chief Minister instructed officials to immediately take up the issue with the ONGC representatives. Mr. Naidu ordered a review of safety protocols in consultation with the ONGC Chairman and other senior officials of the organisation.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Officials told the Chief Minister that residents living within a one-kilometre radius of the gas well had been evacuated. ONGC officials said there was no fire so far and that the wellhead remained secure.

Consultation (Noun)
परामर्श — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consultation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

संगठन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Organisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Corporation (Noun)
निगम — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Corporation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Arrangement (Adjective)
व्यवस्था — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Arrangement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Gas leak at ONGC well in Andhra’s Konaseema; residents within 1 km alerted, road closed", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. There is no blowout or fire so far, officials say; experts are on their way to plug the leak.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Gas leak at ONGC well in Andhra’s Konaseema; res' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Gas leak at ONGC well in Andhra’s Konaseema; ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Gas leak at ONGC well in Andhra’s Konaseema; ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "There is no blowout or fire so far, officials say; experts are on their way to plug the leak." (Hinglish Arth: अधिकारियों का कहना है कि अब तक कोई विस्फोट या आग नहीं लगी है; विशेषज्ञ रिसाव को रोकने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Gas leak at ONGC well in Andhra’s Konaseema; residents within 1 km alerted, road closed"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. ONGC officials said there was no fire so far and that the wellhead remained secure.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "ONGC officials said there was no fire so far and that the wellhead remained secure." (Hinglish Arth: ओएनजीसी के अधिकारियों ने कहा कि अब तक कोई आग नहीं लगी है और कुआं सुरक्षित है।)

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The government late Monday (November 16, 2026) hiked the export duty on diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) by ₹2.5 per litre and ₹1.5 per litre, whilst keeping the levy on export of petrol unchanged at nil.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Duty rates on petrol and diesel meant for domestic consumption remain unchanged. The hike in diesel levy assumes added significance as India looks to further up their exports of the vehicular fuel to Europe amid a global supply crunch. In the upcoming fortnight, diesel exports would draw a levy of ₹14 per litre compared to ₹11.5 per litre mandated for the previous fortnight. ATF exports would draw a levy of ₹12.5 per litre against ₹11 per litre. The government has been conducting a fortnightly review of export levies since March 27, in the backdrop of the conflict in West Asia. These are done based on the average international benchmark prices of crude oil, petrol, diesel and ATF observed since the previous review.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: This is to ensure the domestic availability of retail fuels by disincentivising exports.

articles.title: North Korea’s Kim visits ski resort as Donald Trump hints at possible meeting
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: We may meet with Kim Jong Un also, so that'll be good, Donald Trump told reporters

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un smoked and grinned as he visited a ski resort in pictures released on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), as Donald Trump hinted at a possible meeting between the pair this week. Before departing for China, U.S. President Trump, who met Mr. Kim three times during his first term, left open the possibility of meeting the North Korean leader. "We may meet with Kim Jong Un also, so that'll be good," Mr. Trump told reporters, adding that whether Kim would make the trip was "up to President Xi" of China. As Mr. Trump made the remarks, North Korean state media reported that Kim and his family, accompanied by party officials, travelled to a tourist zone near the northern border with China on Sunday (November 15) and Monday (November 16). Photos released by the official Korean Central News Agency show Kim sitting on a leather chair, grinning, with a cigarette in his hand and sunglasses on, at what appeared to be a ski resort, with his wife Ri Sol Ju standing behind him. Another photo shows his young daughter Ju Ae, whom Seoul's spy agency has said is being groomed to be Kim's successor, skiing downhill in a white outfit but without a helmet. The city of Samjiyon is located near the Chinese border and is close to Mount Paektu, considered by North Koreans to be the sacred birthplace of Kim's father, Jong Il. As he toured the resort, including ski centres and hotels, Kim "expressed great satisfaction, saying that all the structures are really impeccable as they were built in a delicate way", KCNA reported. "The more he looked at it, the more admiration he felt at the spectacular scenery reminiscent of a town in the forest," it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While Mr. Kim made the visit near China, which is hosting the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen, experts say it was unlikely intended to signal plans to travel to the summit.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (17 NOV)

📰 North Korea’s Kim visits ski resort as Donald Trump hints at possible meeting

📌 Published: 17 Nov 2026, 12:28:57 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: We may meet with Kim Jong Un also, so that'll be good, Donald Trump told reporters

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un smoked and grinned as he visited a ski resort in pictures released on Tuesday (November 17, 2026), as Donald Trump hinted at a possible meeting between the pair this week. Before departing for China, U.S. President Trump, who met Mr. Kim three times during his first term, left open the possibility of meeting the North Korean leader. "We may meet with Kim Jong Un also, so that'll be good," Mr. Trump told reporters, adding that whether Kim would make the trip was "up to President Xi" of China. As Mr. Trump made the remarks, North Korean state media reported that Kim and his family, accompanied by party officials, travelled to a tourist zone near the northern border with China on Sunday (November 15) and Monday (November 16). Photos released by the official Korean Central News Agency show Kim sitting on a leather chair, grinning, with a cigarette in his hand and sunglasses on, at what appeared to be a ski resort, with his wife Ri Sol Ju standing behind him. Another photo shows his young daughter Ju Ae, whom Seoul's spy agency has said is being groomed to be Kim's successor, skiing downhill in a white outfit but without a helmet. The city of Samjiyon is located near the Chinese border and is close to Mount Paektu, considered by North Koreans to be the sacred birthplace of Kim's father, Jong Il. As he toured the resort, including ski centres and hotels, Kim "expressed great satisfaction, saying that all the structures are really impeccable as they were built in a delicate way", KCNA reported. "The more he looked at it, the more admiration he felt at the spectacular scenery reminiscent of a town in the forest," it said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: While Mr. Kim made the visit near China, which is hosting the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen, experts say it was unlikely intended to signal plans to travel to the summit.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "North Korea’s Kim visits ski resort as Donald Trump hints at possible meeting", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. We may meet with Kim Jong Un also, so that'll be good, Donald Trump told reporters.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'North Korea’s Kim visits ski resort as Donald Tr' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
